description: Synthetic-only ENE-01 ideal electromechanical one-port energy-closure integration case. All numerical parameters, initial states, normalization scales and input bounds are declared analysis fixtures; none are CNC machine or drive specifications.

provenance.parameter_source: SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE: all numeric parameter values are authored solely for reproducible software/numerical verification. SRC-000369 identifies generic linear-motor parameter conventions, SRC-000372 supports the classical RK4 method, and SRC-000374 supports the conventional gamma_k rounding-error form; none of these sources supplies the numeric values in this configuration or proves the analyst-declared energy/power/trajectory bounds.

electrical.note: Every value is a synthetic fixture. Ke and Kf are set equal in SI units solely to exercise the ideal one-port energy identity; they are not catalogue values or a motor selection.

actuator.displacement_definition_and_sign: Synthetic actuator displacement ell_a = 0.1*q1 + s, with positive ell_a defined by positive s and positive q1 contributions; all coefficients are fixture values.

controller_and_loads.note: Constant 0.8 A synthetic feedforward current command. ENE-01 external generalized forces are exactly zero; no structural damping or axis friction is included. This is a continuous-time idealized model input, not a digital servo command or hardware setting.

metrics.energy_residual_noise_floor_method: Pre-run synthetic-fixture envelope plus binary64 operation-bound analysis. The analyst declares upper bounds for stored-energy evaluation, RK4 trajectory propagation, net-power evaluation/trajectory propagation and time-grid effects before integration; the runner independently derives h/16 composite-Simpson accumulation and energy-residual subtraction bounds using gamma_k=k*u/(1-k*u). No residual from the executed trajectories is used to set this floor. This is a numerical roundoff-noise screen only; it excludes RK4 truncation and model/parameter uncertainty.
metrics.energy_residual_noise_floor_source: Analyst-declared synthetic ENE-01 envelope and roundoff propagation assumptions. SRC-000374 supports the standard gamma_k expression only; the supplied maximum-energy, power, trajectory and time-grid bounds are synthetic assumptions and have not been independently proven or measured.
metrics.state_comparison_scale_source: Per-component characteristic magnitude anchors explicitly declared for this synthetic ENE-01 fixture before integration. The values are scale descriptors in their respective physical units, not tolerances, state bounds or acceptance criteria.
metrics.note: The normalization scale/floor and roundoff noise floor are synthetic pre-run declarations; the normalized closure threshold is intentionally null so this case cannot report engineering PASS. Analyst-supplied envelope and trajectory roundoff bounds are assumptions, not proved by the runner. Config schema v4; manifest schema v7.
